tokens.name: deep-green
tokens.usage: The dominant brand colour: "Egyp", the p, headers, primary buttons, vehicle and sign fields. Text on white, mist and cloud (5.3:1+); white text on it (5.9:1).

tokens.name: leaf-green
tokens.usage: "Green" and the leaf in the logo; graphic accents, chart lines, the pattern. Not for body text (3.2:1 on white: large text only).

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Dark depth colour: footers, the rear of the van, hover state of deep-green buttons. White text on it 10.3:1.

tokens.name: sun-amber
tokens.usage: Accent only, at most about 5% of any layout: the sun, one highlight per page, rating stars, the "new" flag. Ink text on it (7.5:1); never white text, never amber text on white.

tokens.name: amber-deep
tokens.usage: Amber as text: price notes and warnings on white or amber-tint (5.2:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on any light ground (15.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Secondary headings, table headers, product drawings (9.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels and metadata on white, cloud or mist (5.1:1+).

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, placeholder icons, chart gridlines labels at 3:1. Not for reading text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, card and input borders.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Neutral page band and table stripes.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Default ground: generous white space is part of the identity.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet green background for panels and the light pattern.

tokens.name: leaf-tint
tokens.usage: Highlighted rows, selected states, pattern ink on mist.

tokens.name: amber-tint
tokens.usage: Notice boxes ("prices valid until"), promo flags behind ink or amber-deep text.

tokens.name: leaf-light
tokens.usage: Leaf on dark grounds (dark app icon, van rear). 3.5:1 on deep-green.

tokens.name: one-color-black
tokens.usage: The one-colour logo only (stamps, engraving, fax).

styles.name: h1
